user.title: ROMA ROMA ROMA – Red and yellow lights
user.description: Choose the lights that will be RED and the ones that will be YELLOW during the anthem (colors are fixed). If the lamps are powered by a smart plug, select it: it will be switched on before the show.

data_description.power_entities: Optional: e.g. the smart plug powering the lamps.
data_description.min_brightness: Light level in the quietest parts of the song.
data_description.max_brightness: Light level on the strongest hits of the chorus.

media.title: ROMA ROMA ROMA – Song
media.description: The song is fixed: "Antonello Venditti - Roma Roma Roma". For copyright reasons the file is not included: upload it in Media → Local media named "Antonello Venditti - Roma Roma Roma.mp3" (or enter your own media-source path here).

data_description.media_players: Optional: without players only the light show runs.
data_description.sync_offset: If the lights lag behind the music increase this value, if they are ahead decrease it.

alerts.title: ROMA ROMA ROMA – Alerts and presence
alerts.description: The AS Roma calendar (league and cups) updates automatically.

data_description.persons: Optional: if empty the show always starts.

error.no_lights: Select at least one red or yellow light.
error.brightness_range: Minimum brightness must be lower than maximum brightness.
